entities.summary: Jon Lewis Ford is an American former professional baseball outfielder and current manager for the Long Island Ducks of the Atlantic League of Professional Baseball. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins, Baltimore Orioles, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers.
